description: Query poverty and inequality estimates from the World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (PIP) for economies and PIP's own aggregates (World, regions, income, lending, and fragility groups): poverty headcount, gap, and severity at any poverty line, mean and median welfare, and population, plus the Gini, mean log deviation, polarization, and decile shares on survey rows. PIP is separate from the WDI series worldbank_get_data reads: welfare is in PPP dollars per person per day at the vintage ppp_version selects, and its aggregates are computed at any line, where worldbank_get_data carries only the published lines. estimationType tells survey rows from gap-filled estimates, whose inequality fields are null by design rather than missing in error.

anyOf.description: One code, several separated by commas, semicolons, or pipes, or "all".
Codes; an element holding several separated codes is split too.

countries.description: Economies by ISO3 (IND) or ISO2 (IN) code, model-estimate-only ones (AFG) included, or "all" for every economy. PIP's aggregates: WLD; regions AFE, AFW, EAS, ECS, LCN, MEA, NAC, SAS, SSF; income groups HIC, LIC, LMIC (or LMC), UMIC (or UMC); fragility groups FCVY (fragile) and FCVN (not fragile); lending groups IDX (IDA only), IDB or BLND (IDA blend), IBD or IBRD (IBRD only), REST. Income groups use the classification of PIP's data release for every year, so membership can differ from worldbank_get_country's. IDA is rejected (PIP computes no IDA total: ask for IDX and IDB), as are FCS (use FCVY, not asserted to match it), SSA, EAP, MIC, and LMY. welfare_type and reporting_level cannot combine with an aggregate.

fill_gaps.description: True: PIP's estimates fill the years, reporting levels, and welfare types no survey covers, so an unsurveyed year still returns a row; those rows carry no inequality data. False: survey rows only, empty for unsurveyed years and for model-estimate-only economies. No effect on aggregates.

per_page.description: Results per page (default: server default); sizes above 1000 are served at that maximum, with a notice.

poverty_line.description: Poverty line in PPP dollars per person per day at the applied vintage, any threshold; omitted, the international poverty line for that vintage. PIP rounds it to two decimals (6.953 is computed at 6.95): each row's povertyLine is the line applied, appliedFilters.povertyLine the value sent. The inequality fields do not depend on it.

ppp_version.description: PPP vintage for every dollar figure ("2021", "2017"), one PIP's current data release is published at; omitted, the newest.

reporting_level.description: One reporting level. Most economies publish national figures only; China publishes all three for the same year; some publish urban or rural figures in some years, where fill_gaps true adds PIP's national estimate if it has one. Argentina is urban only, so "national" leaves it out.

welfare_type.description: One welfare measure. Income and consumption are not directly comparable, so pin one for a cross-country comparison. Omitted, each economy's published measure, with a row per measure in a year surveyed both ways; gap-filled estimates use one measure per year.

year.description: A four-digit reporting year, "all" (the default) for the full history, or "MRV" for the latest: per economy, PIP's latest estimate year with fill_gaps true or its latest survey year with fill_gaps false; an aggregate's newest year. Coverage runs from 1963 to the last year of PIP's data release.

name: worldbank_get_poverty

appliedFilters.description: The query as sent to PIP; a filter not applied is omitted.

countries.description: Codes as queried, comma-joined: uppercased, deduplicated, ISO2 resolved to three characters (NG → NGA), and WDI group spellings read as PIP's (LMC → LMIC, IDB → BLND, IBD → IBRD). Each can be sent back as countries.

perPage.description: Page size served, after any reduction to the page maximum.

pppVersion.description: PPP vintage of every dollar figure.

releaseVersion.description: PIP data release (YYYYMMDD), the newest PIP lists.

requestedPerPage.description: Page size asked for, or the server default; present only when perPage was reduced.

currentPage.description: Page number; past totalPages when the request ran off the end.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `country_not_found`: A code names no economy or aggregate PIP publishes. `ambiguous_aggregate`: IDA or XG asks for WDI's IDA total, which PIP does not compute. `unserved_aggregate`: An aggregate code this tool does not serve, such as FCS, SSA, or MIC. `aggregate_filter_conflict`: welfare_type or reporting_level is set with an aggregate code. `invalid_parameter`: PIP rejected a parameter value. `ppp_version_unavailable`: ppp_version is not a vintage PIP's current release is published at. `upstream_unavailable`: PIP returned a server error, or the country listing that resolves ISO2 codes did not load. `upstream_timeout`: The call's 50-second budget ran out before PIP or the ISO2 country listing answered, or a PIP request ran past its 90-second bound. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

estimates.description: Estimates on this page, ordered by code, year, reporting level, then welfare type.

items.description: An economy × year × reporting level × welfare type estimate, or an aggregate × year.

comparableSpell.description: Years the comparable series covers, as PIP labels it ("2011 - 2022").

countryCode.description: Economy ISO3 code, or the aggregate code (IDX for IDA only); accepted back as countries.

decileShares.description: Each decile's share of income or consumption, poorest first, summing to 1.

distributionType.description: Distribution classification: micro, group, or imputed; null when none is published.

estimateType.description: Estimate classification: actual, nowcast, or projection; null when none is published. Independent of estimationType.

estimationType.description: How the row was produced. Economy rows: "survey", or gap-filled "interpolation", "extrapolation", or "CMD estimation" (no survey at all), whose gini, mld, polarization, decileShares, surveyYear, surveyComparability, and comparableSpell are null. Aggregate rows: "actual", "nowcast", or "projection".

headcount.description: Share of the population below the line, as a fraction (0.0814 = 8.14%).

isAggregate.description: True on a PIP aggregate row, whose regionCode, regionName, reportingLevel, welfareType, median, gini, mld, polarization, decileShares, surveyYear, surveyComparability, comparableSpell, and isInterpolated are null and surveyAcronym is empty.

isInterpolated.description: True on interpolated and extrapolated rows but false on a gap-filled "CMD estimation" row, so read estimationType.

mean.description: Mean daily welfare per person in PPP dollars.

median.description: Median daily welfare per person in PPP dollars.

popInPoverty.description: People below the line, published on aggregate rows; null on economy rows, where population × headcount gives it.

povertyGap.description: Mean shortfall below the line across the population, as a fraction of the line.

povertyLine.description: Poverty line applied, in PPP dollars per person per day.

povertySeverity.description: Squared poverty gap, weighting the poorest most.

regionCode.description: PIP region code, such as SAS.

surveyAcronym.description: Survey short name; empty on gap-filled rows and where none is published.

surveyComparability.description: Comparability code within the economy, 0 for its oldest series and stepping up at each break; two survey rows compare over time only when they share it.

surveyYear.description: Survey year, fractional when the survey spans a fiscal year (2022.58).

notice.description: Explains an empty result, a page past the end, a reduced page size, gap-filled or aggregate rows, gap-filled estimates PIP failed to return, or economies fill_gaps false left out.

title: Get World Bank Poverty and Inequality Estimates
